# Unbound Scene Context

Every Unbound stub in Binding Codex with its **whole scene**, in the order the player reads it: 83 scenes, 104 stubs.

**Written so far:** 88 stub ids (✅ in the scenes below); the rest are marked ✍️. To revise a written one, edit its lines in `js/unbound_lines.js`, or send new text and Momo will swap it in.

*Generated by `node tools/stub_context.mjs` from the game's event data. Don't edit this file by hand; rerun the script after changing a scene. The writing notes come from `UNBOUND_GUIDE.md`.*

## How to read this

- Each scene shows the lines leading up to the stub, every choice (the one that leads to your scene is marked), and the **Gentle** and **Steamy** lines.
- On Unbound the player sees the **Steamy** line first, then yours. Pick up where it leaves off.
- Lines marked *(only if …)* appear in some playthroughs only. Don't lean on them in your text.
- Write your lines into the stub in the file named in the section heading. Search for the stub id.

- *"Sit beside her."*: Calla's first night out of the cells, on the library roof under the sky she'd forgotten. Very tender, very tentative. She keeps asking "is this allowed?" This is her first real choice in years, so make every step of it hers.
